WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 It’s the end of the world and the Four Horsemen rise to bring terror and death to the mortal worlds. Prepare to walk the line between Life and Death in this 6-reel, 5-row game with payline wins, where each spin brings you closer to the final reckoning. Embrace the shadows and seek the max win of 15,000 times your bet, achievable across all game modes. Will you rise or fall as the Horsemen ride?

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Wild Multiplier symbols substitute for all other symbols in the paytable.
